newsitem.title: USA: Four Corners, N.M., 750 MW coal unit near 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Four Corners, N.M., 750 MW coal unit near 100 pct.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico is near 100 percent capacity after starting to ramp up on Monday, a spokesman for the plant said Tuesday.
The unit had tripped off-line last Wednesday due to a tube rupture.
Four Corners' other 750 MW unit plus a 245 MW unit and two 185 MW units were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service Co, a unit of Pinnacle West Capital, operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
